name: Cheddar
long_description:
Ditch your bare-bones, high-fee checking account. You deserve free and powerful everyday banking.

Nearly 3 out of 4 millennials would rather go to the dentist than listen to their bank. While it's possible that we just really love our oral hygiene, it's more likely that we don't trust or like our banks.

It's not hard to understand why. Big banks use big budgets and armies of salespeople and marketers to sell old-school products layered with fees and penalties. Their profits increase when we spend more, overuse debt, and make mistakes like overdrafting.

Big banks get away with this because banking is such a vital service. Everyday spending and saving decisions that begin at the checking account ultimately determine whether we'll lead a healthy and secure financial life.

What can be done? Bill Gates believes banks aren't necessary for banking. Millennials believe technology companies can make banking better. So let's build a better bank. Cheddar is a new mobile bank account, debit card, and business model to free the world from underpowered checking accounts and evil banks.
one_liner: The Best Mobile Checking Account

launches.title: Cardda 💵 ⚡️ - Business payments simplified in Latam
launches.tagline: Meet Cardda, the simplest way for Latam companies to make their payments
launches.body:
**TL;DR** We're building [Cardda](https://cardda.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launchyc&utm_id=launchyc&utm_content=1), the simplest way for Latam companies to make their payments. We give corporate credit cards, tools for bill payments and automated local transfers.

> Hi everyone! 👋 We are Sebastián and Cristóbal, and would love to tell you about [Cardda](https://cardda.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launchyc&utm_id=launchyc&utm_content=2).
>
> # **Problem**

---

---

1. Businesses are wasting a lot of time paying other businesses, it's common to hear questions like: who approved this invoice?, who initiated this payment?, should we pay the supplier this week or next week?
2. Employee expenses and reimbursements: receipts lost, reconciliation time consuming, visibility on payments weeks after purchases made, no control over what employees can pay and no budgets
3. Corporate cards are slow to obtain, have poor spending controls and transactions aren't incorporated with company's accounting systems

---

# **Solution**

We enable companies to **initiate, track and reconcile every payment** they make to other businesses, using the local payments methods accepted by business and showing all the accounts payable in real time through direct integration with each country's invoice system.

API and dashboard to **automate mass local payouts.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65557&key=user_uploads/285661/4980c335-7df2-4626-9cd5-20d989706c8b)

**Unlimited physical and virtual corporate credit cards** with granular controls to pay for their expenses, real time visibility in each purchase, set spending controls and option to block merchants.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65557&key=user_uploads/285661/0f9e9a56-0656-46dc-87bd-8f89d9cbdc04)

---

# **Ask 🤝**

* If you are wasting time paying your bills, making reimbursements or your corporate cards aren't great, please reach out to us, would be thrilled to help!
* Intros to companies in any vertical in Latam that are making more than 50 monthly payments
* Follow us [here](https://cl.linkedin.com/company/cardda)

---

**We would love to talk to you! 🤩, please** [**click here**](https://calendly.com/cardda/15-yc) **for a 15 min chat or reach us at** [**founders@cardda.com**](mailto:founders@cardda.com)

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82277&key=user_uploads/556140/a5ad7448-63b6-42a8-934d-3a149c352ec1)

When we started Grey in 2020, we just wanted to make it easy for people like us to receive payments for work without any stress. Over the last four years, we’ve enabled global banking access to digital nomads across the US, UK, Europe, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and Nigeria.

Today, I’m excited to announce that Grey is now available to remote workers, digital nomads, and creatives in **Brazil** 🇧🇷, **Ghana** 🇬🇭, **Indonesia** 🇮🇩, **Mexico** 🇲🇽, the **Philippines** 🇵🇭, and **South Africa** 🇿🇦! Get started at [grey.co](http://grey.co).

In the next few weeks, we’ll roll out to more Latin America (LATAM) and Southeast Asia (SEA) countries. If you’re a digital nomad, freelancer, or remote worker in these countries, you can enjoy the following:

* Get a free USD, EUR, or GBP account to receive your salary and payments.
* Convert to other currencies (MXN, BRL, PHP, IDR, ZAR, NGN, KES, TZS, GHS, etc) and send to your local bank account or mobile money wallet.
* Get a virtual card to spend.
* Send Stablecoins (USDC) to your external wallet addresses.

We’re on a mission to make globalisation work for everyone by providing inclusive banking solutions regardless of location, and this expansion takes us six steps closer today.

If you know any communities we should speak to or any person in these markets we should connect to, please let us know at [founders@grey.co](mailto:founders@grey.co).

launches.body:
# [**👋**](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand) Hi YC,

I’m Alex, founder of [Arpari](https://www.arpari.com/). Over the past 3 years, we’ve been working with commercial real estate finance teams to streamline their bank account data. We’ve built a multibank dashboard to provide a single login to teams working with hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks. 

💸 Today we’ve launched **multibank payments**, further reducing the need for teams to log into separate bank portals. Now, teams can fully manage their account inventory, reconcile transactions, and make transfers in a single dashboard.  

🚀 Recently, we have **expanded our focus beyond** real estate to satisfy all entity structures. Whether you are a small finance team with a simple account structure or you deal with hundreds of subsidiaries and entities and the complexity that brings, Arpari makes it easy to streamline your bank-related processes. 

# **TL;DR**

* Arpari centralizes account inventory, balances, and transactions across all your accounts, making month-end processes a breeze
* Our dashboard works with any number of banks and complex entity structures 
* Today, we launched payments so your team just needs to log into a single portal to set up and approve all payments to vendors, investors and anyone else
* Do you know any finance teams that work with more than one bank? Please introduce us! Email [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com) or [book a demo here](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo)

  

# **❌ The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/57361321-c472-4677-955d-e6feecc21f04)

Finance teams who are responsible for balance reporting and transaction reconciliation often scramble at month end, don’t report at the frequency they’d like, or sacrifice reporting accuracy altogether.   

1. **ACCOUNT INVENTORY**: Using multiple banks can mean liquidity is an unknown, especially for teams who work with many accounts. Bank accounts tracked in Excel—many unnamed or vaguely labeled—makes effective management nearly impossible. Often accounts are missed, and cash misplaced. 
2. **MANAGING ACCESS**: Financial operations are severely hindered by fragmented bank access scattered across multiple team members. Accountants regularly need separate logins, deal with constant lockouts, and navigate multiple security code requests, reducing productivity. Add in payment approval workflows, and you have duplicate, complex permissions to manage across multiple portals. 
3. **DATA NORMALIZATION**: Beyond data access, when teams finally gather transaction data across banks, the data comes through in various formats. Many banks only offer PDF downloads, some banks don’t even provide export.  
4. **TRANSFER MONITORING**: Teams need to log into multiple portals to monitor pending transactions and approvals. Additionally, when vendor or investor bank details change, they need to update the information across multiple portals.

 

Teams who have tried to solve this problem have found treasury software that doesn’t work for multibank users. Incumbent solutions price with bank-by-bank implementation, which doesn’t work for users who have hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks, with their account and bank list constantly in flux. 

  

# 👩‍💻  **Our Solution: One login for all finance teams needs**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/7bf3d96a-04c3-4687-b9a6-6d369a929170)

  

We’ve built a dashboard for finance teams to interact in one place. When teams are doing the same manual tasks 10+ times, why not do them once? 

### STABLE CONNECTIONS

We leverage various connection methods to banks to provide stable, usable data daily to our customers. The account, balance, and activity information is the foundation to all workflows for our customers; unifying this information into a single place gives them back time for month-end reporting, peace of mind, and full transparency of their true cash flow.  

### DASHBOARD CUSTOMIZATION

We offer added customization to help organize account, balance, and activity data. Our dashboard is built around teams with complex fund and entity structures and prioritizes easy navigation according to how our users think about their bank information. 

### SINGLE PORTAL ACCESS

With payment approval workflows and read-only access, finance teams no longer need to permission non-account signers into bank portals. Finance teams can conduct their day-to-day operations without needing to log into 10+ portals to make payments or pull activity. 

  

Whether you are the controller sending investor distributions and paying vendors, an executive who wants a headline snapshot of cash, or an accountant reconciling transactions, Arpari saves you time. 

  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/a04f6c1b-0560-4b46-88f3-006cef73f664)

# **🙏  Ask**

* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/arpari/), and [book a demo](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo) with our team. 
* **Share this post!** -  Do you know anyone in your network who is a CFO, controller, account manager, or treasurer? Please share this post! 
* Learn more at [arpari.com](http://arpari.com)

 

👉 Contact me at [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com)

Hi YC! We’re [@Alexandre Roubaud](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/710971) & [@Kabir Sethi](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/711533), the founders of Bitstack.

[**Bitstack**](https://bitstack-app.com/) **is the easiest way to save and invest in Bitcoin in Europe. 🇪🇺**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64459&key=user_uploads/710971/48d95d1b-f5d5-43b3-93f0-89bd95091a38)

Bitstack is the easiest way for people in Europe to get their first crypto wallet. Users can get started by turning their spare change into bitcoin and then use the app to buy, sell, earn and spend new digital currencies like bitcoin.

Simply download the app, securely link your bank account and you’re all set. Bitstack will automatically round up your everyday purchases to the nearest euro and invest the spare change in Bitcoin.

There is no need to determine the right time to buy and no investment knowledge required.

### **Why should you save in Bitcoin?**

Today, 2 out of 3 people are worried about not achieving their financial goals, whether that’s buying a house, saving for retirement, a vacation, or their children’s future.

Unfortunately, most people continue saving in low-interest savings accounts that are consistently outpaced over the years by rising inflation.

But Bitcoin fixes this. Bitcoin is the first open, global and permissionless monetary network with a fixed supply of 21 million bitcoins, ever, and protected by a distributed network of users all around the world.

**So we built Bitstack to finally make it simple, fun and accessible for everyone to save and invest in Bitcoin.**

### **What our users say**

Since the launch of our Beta 3 months ago, we’ve already helped our users save **1.5+ billion satoshis**. Did you know? 1 Bitcoin = 100 million satoshis.

* “Bitstack is a fun way to build up savings and get started with Bitcoin!”
* “It’s the best app for me as I don’t know how to save.”
* “Very convenient to dollar-cost-average without having to think about it.”

### **How do I get started?**

**Download the app now 👉** <https://bitstack-app.com/download>

**Ask**: Give us feedback at [founders@bitstack-app.com](mailto:founders@bitstack-app.com) so we can make this product even better, and tell your family and friends in Europe to try us out!

Thanks! **🧡**

Hello! Amer from [nsave](https://www.nsave.com) here.

[nsave](https://www.nsave.com) opens a trusted $€£ account abroad for people from unstable economies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79615&key=user_uploads/794827/4e721169-1c41-4ff6-bfb8-c98bdce7309e)

**Why?** 🔥

I grew up in Syria and saw my family lose their life savings due to inflation and the inability to open a safe bank account abroad after the war.

Unfortunately, when you come from a distressed country, banks label you as a "high-risk" client and, in most cases, refuse to provide banking services.

I worked abroad in the black market for two years, and when I had to move again, I traveled with my savings in cash, literally strapped to my body.

I had no choice. And like me, there are 700 million people globally who don't have access to safe banking purely because of their origin. This is wrong.

That's why we started nsave. Because everyone deserves the right to protect their hard-earned money in a safe place, regardless of where they come from.

**Who are we?** 😃

[Amer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amer-baroudi/) (CEO), and [Abdallah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aabuhash/) (CTO), two Rhodes Scholars who grew up in Damascus and Gaza and had destiny bring us to meet in Oxford. Together with an incredible team, we are on a mission to build a more inclusive global financial system.

Collectively, we have experience in banking, regulatory compliance, and fintech and have worked for Morgan Stanley, Revolut, EY, Checkout, BNYM, Microsoft, and Robinhood.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79615&key=user_uploads/794827/946ee2f8-89c1-4ee7-8711-1588765b4059)

* Bitcoin-native companies

launches.title: Theya: World's simplest Bitcoin multi-sig, self-custody app
launches.tagline: We are building the default consumer app for Bitcoin - offering products like accumulation, lending, investments and payments - all built on top of our intuitive self-custody platform.
launches.body:
### **Tl:dr**

Theya is the world’s simplest Bitcoin self-custody app for whole-coiners (users with >1BTC) who find crypto exchanges risky and hardware wallets overwhelming. We simplify the self-custody UX through our multi-device, multi-sig wallet that users can set up using smartphones, giving you the functionality and convenience of centralized exchanges without sacrificing control and security of hardware wallets.

### **Team**

Vikas, Sriram and Smeet have extensive background in founding and scaling tech companies and crypto platforms over the past 10 years. Founders have been friends for over 15 years.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70576&key=user_uploads/1235724/1abfbd7f-b023-47b1-8c54-ddf9bd32371f)

Vikas was previously the co-founder and CTO of Porter, India’s largest intra-city logistics marketplace that does over $220M in annual revenue. He raised over $150M from Sequoia Capital and Tiger Global during his 7 years at Porter. While studying at Stanford, Vikas founded an ML-driven real estate fund that has invested over $30M.

Sriram has led crypto engineering teams at Robinhood, FalconX and GameStop Blockchain. He built crypto custody infra and led the development of self-custody wallets for Robinhood and GameStop. He started his career at Google and has over 10 years of experience building consumer apps. Sriram graduated with Bachelors in Computer Science from IIT Bombay.

Smeet has led marketing and go-to-market teams at multiple early-stage startups. Prior to Theya, he was the first business hire at Prodigal (YC S18). He started his career at Deutsche Bank and has 8+ years of experience trading macro assets like FX, Bonds, Equities and believes that long Bitcoin is the most important trade of the 2020s.

### **Problem:**

The protection of your wealth and trust is paramount, which is why we exist. The reality is that centralized crypto platforms like FTX, Celsius, and Voyager have failed to ensure the safety of their users' Bitcoin. More recently, there are renewed concerns about Binance.

As the saying goes, **"not your keys, not your Bitcoin"** and this is more true now than ever before. Every user who stores Bitcoin on popular crypto exchanges faces severe counterparty risks, including:

**Credit Risk:** If your crypto exchange was to go bankrupt (like FTX) or suffer a catastrophic event, your Bitcoin stored there is certainly at risk.

**Regulatory Risk:** Any change in laws or regulations, crypto exchanges may be forced to freeze or confiscate your Bitcoin.

**Cybersecurity Risk:** While centralized exchanges invest in security measures, they are prime targets for cyber attacks. Successful hackers can steal users’ Bitcoin from hot wallets.

Self-custody hardware wallets are a solution, but they come with their own set of challenges. They have a messy user experience, and users are responsible for managing their own setup, security, and backup keys. Furthermore, they represent a single point of failure. These risks make it crucial to prioritize the protection of your Bitcoin, and we are here to help you do just that.

### **Solution:**

Our multisig wallet is like a digital safe where you need multiple keys to unlock it. For example, our 2-of-3 multi-sig wallet requires two out of three keys to approve a transaction before the Bitcoin can be spent.

Customers will always hold the two keys necessary to approve transactions. Theya holds the third key that can only be used for recovery if you misplace one of your keys, but it can never be used to transfer funds on its own.

Theya is simplifying the self-custody experience through a mobile-first multisig wallet that families can set up using iPhones and Apple Watches. We also support other devices such as NFC cards, hardware wallets, and more that can be used as your additional keys if desired. We make your Bitcoin resilient to phishing and hacking and you retain control of your Bitcoin wealth even if we fail without notice.

### **Ask**

1. If you currently hold Bitcoin on centralized exchanges like Coinbase, Binance, Robinhood, Kraken, Gemini etc. you should definitely consider taking self-custody. Hit us up for a free trial to the simplest Bitcoin self-custody app ever.
2. Reach out if you are curious to learn about Theya, Bitcoin and the ongoing global banking crisis, feel free to reach out.

launches.body:
VaultPay is a digital banking platform bringing Visa cards and modern financial services to the Democratic Republic of Congo, a country of 120 million people where 85% remain unbanked, and 90% of transactions happen in US dollars.

**The Problem**

The DRC has been overlooked by the fintech industry. While mobile money dominates most of Africa with razor-thin margins, the DRC's dollarized economy means our users transact at an average of $40/month, nearly 3x Nigeria's $15 average. Higher transaction values mean healthy unit economics from day one.

**What We Built**

Think Apple Wallet meets CashApp. We offer virtual and physical Visa cards, USD and CDF accounts, and we're rolling out an agency banking network that transforms local businesses into cash-in/cash-out points, following the Square model for Africa.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97421&key=user_uploads/350695/198f0423-193f-4546-8c38-c6c46dc243bc)

**Traction**

We launched in Q4 2025. In four months, with zero marketing spend:

* 17,000+ users signed up
* $20K MRR
* 80% are accessing formal financial services for the first time

**Why Now**

We're the first startup to secure a full payment license from the Central Bank of Congo, rather than operating under another bank's license, as most African fintechs do. This opened doors: Visa invested in our launch and is finalizing a deal recognizing us as their distribution partner for DRC expansion. Ecobank, one of Africa's largest banks, chose us to power its card experience, integrating its CashXpress program ($15M in monthly cash-in volume) into our platform.

**Team**

We left Airbnb and Google in Silicon Valley to build this. Backed by YCombinator, Tekedia Capital, Michael Seibel, executives from SoFi, Airbnb, and CashApp, and engineers from Google DeepMind, Meta, and Uber.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97421&key=user_uploads/350695/9bb15e33-5144-43ed-b8f1-c75f8fd8f2ba)

AI collapsed what should have taken years into months. We own our entire stack, including product, KYC, analytics, customer service, and data science, all with a very small team.

**The Opportunity**

Everyone chases the same markets in Africa. Meanwhile, we're building the financial rails for an entire nation before others catch on. That is our moat. DRC is currently undergoing a massive nationwide digital transformation and is one of the continent's largest consumer markets.\
\
**Our Ask**

We're raising our seed round to accelerate distribution across the DRC and Central Africa. If you're an investor excited about the largest untapped fintech market on the continent, we'd love to talk.

If you want to join a fast-growing startup building the financial foundations of an entire region, we're hiring.

Email: [ntambwa@vaultpay.io](mailto:ntambwa@vaultpay.io) / [cilaka@vaultpay.io](mailto:cilaka@vaultpay.io) / [founders@vaultpay.io](mailto:founders@vaultpay.io)

**TLDR** We're a consumer budgeting app with built-in banking.

**PROBLEM**

Saving, investing, and meeting wealth milestones are critical for good financial health, but are often boring or stress-inducing. It doesn’t pack the same dopamine punch as 2% cash back. This leaves us with a gaping disparity between the average total consumer debt of $101,915 and the 63 percent of Americans who don't have enough saved to cover a $500 financial setback.

We— [**@Josh Cockrell Strobel**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshuakcockrell/) and [**@Katelyn Strobel**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/katelynstrobel/)— run a 75K+ subscriber YouTube channel, and have vlogged our personal finance journey as a couple in Silicon Valley. We had nothing we could confidently recommend.

So, we decided to use our backgrounds in consumer fintech (Katelyn worked on marketing projects for Apple Card, Acorns, and Digit, and Josh worked as a programmer on the Robinhood & Twitter iOS apps) to create our personal finance platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73974&key=user_uploads/226037/e515a2c0-56a8-4a59-ac75-cb2df7c7818f)

We facilitate all of this through a digital “cash” envelopes system, custom goals, and tailored analytics.

International knowledge workers earn in USD but live their day-to-day in Pesos. Moving money across borders is costly, complex and the existing banking infrastructure is slow. On average, a knowledge worker will lose $1,000 per year in hidden ForEx and transfer fees. In that process, their money will touch at least 3 different accounts adding time and steps along the way.

Coba is the app where users can:

* Access a single account to deposit their payroll, save in USD and send funds to Mexico.
* Transfer Mexican Pesos to local bank accounts in seconds without fees and at competitive FX rates.
* Receive a local credit card for daily expenses in Pesos that draws from their USD balance.

* **Trust**: Coba runs on existing, regulated banking infrastructure and tools
* **Convenience**: A single app for two currencies
* **Efficiency**: Proprietary payment rails mean more competitive FX rates and savings for our Users

### **🇺🇸💸🇲🇽 Why Us?**

From the Near-shoring capital of Latin America, Monterrey, MX, we live a cross-border reality. Not only have we employed remote teams across LatAm in the businesses we have operated, but we are remote workers ourselves and know first-hand the costs and complexity of moving money from USD to Pesos.

**Tl;dr:** We can increase a real estate owner’s property values by 20 percent in less than three months. We already have thousands of units on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of 8M units in 2026.

We’re [Alvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alvinsalehi/) & [Greg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gregrami/) and we’re the founders of [Goldbridge](https://www.goldbridgebanking.com/). Alvin’s first YC company, Shef (W19), is a homemade food marketplace that helped change state laws across the country so that people could legally cook and sell food from home. They raised over $100M, scaled Shef nationally, and built it into a Series B company that continues to grow rapidly across the country.

Now we’re building Goldbridge, the financial operating system for real estate – and we built it from the ground up based on our personal experience owning and operating residential properties.

**THE PROBLEM**

Over **$1 trillion** **of rent** flows through landlords’ bank accounts every year, and nearly 25% of it sits idle in reserves and deposits. In other words, **real estate banking is fundamentally broken**:

* Traditional banks don’t understand real estate cashflows
* Property management systems don’t handle money movement, treasury, or yield
* Operators juggle multiple bank accounts, spreadsheets, and manual reconciliations
* Billions are lost every year in missed yield, overpayments, and operational inefficiencies

This is one of the largest underserved financial categories in the country.

**WHY WE BUILT GOLDBRIDGE**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/286eb9a4-254e-43a5-b09c-1e451fbb85ce)

As the son of immigrants, Alvin grew up in a motel and helped his parents manage properties growing up. Now he owns 81 units in the Bay Area, and he’s personally experienced how painful it is to manage property finances once you hit mid-market scale (50+ units).

By modernizing his banking stack, renegotiating contracts, appealing his property tax bills, applying for government rebates, optimizing maintenance spend, and restructuring rent collections, Alvin took his 81-unit portfolio from **–2% burn → +36% cashflow in just a few months.**

We’ve now replicated this for other property owners, and the patterns are universal.

**OUR SOLUTION**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/de43ac4b-4268-4af9-8522-7410002f340c)

**1. Banking Built for Real Estate**

High yield operating accounts, reserve accounts, and automated reconciliations across your entire portfolio of properties -- all under one FDIC-backed infrastructure.

**2. Automated Savings & Earnings Optimization**

Goldbridge automatically surfaces:

* Property-tax reassessment opportunities
* Vendor contract renegotiation opportunities
* Government rebate and incentive programs
* Utility bill errors
* Idle cash yield optimization
* Reserve allocation improvements

Because Goldbridge sits at the **banking + transaction layer**, we have access to data that is cleaner, richer, and more accurate than generic financial platforms. On top of that, we can actually move money for owners intelligently and safely rather than just highlighting the issues that need to be resolved and throwing the manual work back onto their plates.

**WHY NOW**

**1. A $2.5T Refi Wall Is Coming (2027–2028)**

An estimated $2.5 trillion in real estate loans will mature soon, which is making owners desperate to improve their property finances. They will need pristine financials, liquidity discipline, and real-time visibility into how their money moves.

**2. LLMs Unlock Automation in a Data-Dense Industry**

Needless to say, real estate produces massive amounts of invoices, leases, utility bills, tax docs, contracts, rent rolls, and loan agreements. What previously took days to review and reconcile can now be done in minutes.

**TRACTION**

We’re moving extremely fast. We already have **thousands of units** on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of **8M units** in 2026.

launches.body:
### **TLDR;**

[GoldenBasis](https://www.goldenbasis.com) makes it easy for brokerages (think Schwab or Fidelity) to run their back office with modern software, and we’re starting with investment account transfers. For example, when you want to transfer your stocks from Schwab to Fidelity, GoldenBasis would let Fidelity gather your transfer information, track the status of your transfer, and automatically update their internal records.

### **Ask**

If you or someone you know is leading a brokerage operations team and wants to improve their account transfer process, please reach out at [founders@goldenbasis.com](mailto:founders@goldenbasis.com)!

### **A quick primer on account transfers**

* Account transfers exist so you can move to a new brokerage without selling your positions, which could incur taxes.
* Incoming account transfers are a primary source of growth for brokerages.
* Over $90 billion of assets are transferred every month in the US. Surprisingly, 18% of these transfers are delayed, often for several weeks \[1\].

**How the process works**

Let’s say you want to transfer your assets from Schwab to Fidelity. The following needs to happen:

* You fill out an account transfer form at Fidelity.
* Fidelity sends this information to Schwab.
* Schwab tells Fidelity what assets are in your account.
* Fidelity makes sure they can hold these assets.
* Your assets move to Fidelity a few days later.

This back-and-forth process is part of a standard protocol called ACATS, and it lets brokerages transfer assets to each other electronically \[2\]. The process above sounds straightforward, but there are hundreds of edge cases detailed in manuals that total over 1000 pages.

### **Problem**

Transfers are supposed to take 3-4 days but often take weeks. During the transfer:

* You can’t trade your assets.
* To find out the status of your transfer, you need to contact customer support.
* The brokerage receiving your assets is missing out on revenue.
* The brokerage delivering your assets gets in trouble with the regulators if they don’t go quickly enough.

Why are delays so common? It’s because there are multiple rounds of manual data entry and any small mistake (e.g. missing comma) can delay the transfer. Furthermore, the operations team has to resolve issues on outdated platforms that are hard to use.

Here’s a taste of the experience today:

* You begin the transfer by filling out a daunting form.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78734&key=user_uploads/714908/c77b27cb-a621-4364-a3dc-4f2f371897b0)

* The brokerage operations team re-enters your form and handles issues in a back-office system.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78734&key=user_uploads/714908/9a53a162-695a-40b4-a41a-a7cc1cb1834d)


### **Solution**

GoldenBasis provides a modern software stack that solves these issues:

* With GoldenBasis, you don’t need to fill out any forms. Just upload your account statement from the brokerage you want to leave, and our AI extracts and validates the fields, which vastly reduces errors.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78734&key=user_uploads/714908/1966b057-cc89-42ab-b4ce-acc20f50d53a)

* GoldenBasis lets you easily track the status of your transfer so you know what’s going on without having to contact support.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78734&key=user_uploads/714908/984e522f-5537-4876-b8d3-748ca0971ed5)

* GoldenBasis provides modern GUIs for the operations team to handle issues.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78734&key=user_uploads/714908/234c33e9-a876-4aba-9080-30c7d741a042)


### **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78734&key=user_uploads/714908/9c49f965-4e87-4d7e-86ec-eb85ead3e823)

[Grant](https://linkedin.com/in/grant-a-391184a5) (CEO) met [Andrew](https://linkedin.com/in/andrew-wang-0b5526109) (CTO) in college at Princeton, where they became best friends. In fact, Andrew was the best man at Grant’s wedding. They teamed up to take on their biggest adventure yet: building a startup and reading a couple thousand pages of manuals along the way.

Before GoldenBasis, Grant worked at Altruist, where he discovered the outdated technology that was causing so much pain for brokerage back offices. He also led Altruist’s integration of SSG post-acquisition, which made Altruist the third-largest custodian for financial advisors, behind Charles Schwab and Fidelity. Before that, Grant helped grow Princeton’s endowment from $26.1 billion to $37.7 billion as a member of the 20-person investment staff.

Before GoldenBasis, Andrew did quant research and software engineering at Citadel, where he built trading systems that process billions of dollars per day. Before that, he worked at Bridgewater, where he wrote software to model global economies and trade fixed-income securities. Andrew loved the prospect of bringing legacy systems to the modern age, especially the back office since it’s so often neglected.

\[2\] <https://www.investopedia.com/terms/a/acat.asp>
